stage: prospective follow-up after distillation and heldout pair results
question: On natural digit labels and all observed 3x3 tasks, does gate/up Mirror reduce real stored FFN bytes without sacrificing test quality versus same-param gate or full independent?
data: sklearn digits images; stratified split 60/20/20 each world; no pretrained Mirror teachers; exact same compositional tasks as DMFFN-003
learning: binary BCE from natural task labels; full-batch labels for all nine tasks, not oracle distillation

dev.selection: mean validation BCE across all six methods

gate: Mirror at most 1.10x independent test BCE and <=0.5x inference bytes, and <=0.9x gain test BCE in >=2/3 worlds; report train budget/time
scope: natural digit labels, constructed compositional binary tasks, not real FFN checkpoint migration or Transformer inference
